name: airbrake_groups
description: Airbrake error groups (issues). Actions: list with filters, get, mute, unmute, delete, get_stats (v5 time-series; requires time__gte and period, optional time__lt (defaults to now) and limit; times are Unix seconds or ISO 8601). resolve/unresolve follow the mute/unmute PUT convention but are not in the public docs — fall back to airbrake_request if they fail on your instance. group_id and deploy_id MUST be passed as strings (they are 19-digit snowflakes that lose precision as JS numbers). List results include `_pagination.has_more`/`next_page`. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload — no data is removed.

order.description: Sort order for the result set

time__gte.description: Inclusive lower bound (required for get_stats). Either Unix seconds as an integer (e.g. 1699485224, the format shown in Airbrake's docs; a digit-only string is read the same way) or an ISO 8601 string (e.g. 2026-05-17T00:00:00Z). Sent to Airbrake exactly as given.

time__lt.description: Exclusive upper bound (optional; omit to let Airbrake default to the current time). Either Unix seconds as an integer (e.g. 1699485224, the format shown in Airbrake's docs; a digit-only string is read the same way) or an ISO 8601 string (e.g. 2026-05-17T00:00:00Z). Sent to Airbrake exactly as given.

period.description: Bucket granularity (required for get_stats). Airbrake's docs list `minute` and `hour`; `day` is not in the public docs and is kept for backward compatibility (use `hour` if your instance rejects it).

limit.description: Maximum number of buckets to return (optional; Airbrake defaults to 100)
